The bipartisan SMART for TBI Act alongside @RepJasonCrow will use AI and digital health technologies to advance TBI care for our service men and women.

More:

There's obviously got to be some regulation of AI, but at the same time, I mean, America needs to be the leader in artificial intelligence,

We need to set up a very light touch regulatory scheme at the federal level that protects children, protects families, but we shouldn't overregulate it. And that's usually what happens with new technology as people get afraid of it.
We're using AI in the architecture for Golden Dome, protecting the United States, making the decision of, 'Oh, is this really an incoming threat?' It can do things like that lightning fast.

Permitting delays are holding America back. To unleash American energy, meet rising demand, and beat China in the AI race, we need a permitting system that works. 

That’s why I supported the SPEED Act in @NatResources markup - and will support it on the floor tomorrow.

Thank you to the team at Western Digital for inviting us to tour their facility. Western Digital makes next-generation hard drives to support America’s AI dominance and supports high-skilled jobs in the district. https://t.co/btmXoHP98f

Philips is a health technology company with more than 530 employees in Colorado Springs. 
 
Chief Region Leader Jeff DiLullo updated me on how Philips continues to support manufacturing and research efforts for AI technology for hospitals. Philips provides medical devices to the VA and Department of War that proactively cares for our veterans and service members. Their work is essential to serving the warfighter, our veterans, and civilians across the country. #CO05

Shivam’s Academic Canvas app is now displayed in our U.S. Capitol. The app works with AI to give every student applying to college a simplified and personalized preparation process as it helps students monitor their grades, extracurriculars, and goals.

For years, Booz Allen has been delivering superior technology focused on cybersecurity and AI, ensuring we lead as a nation and outperform our adversaries.

I met with their Colorado team to discuss the company's growing presence in our state, including more than 500 employees in CO-05, and hear about the work they’re doing in our community to strengthen our national security while supporting local jobs.

I welcome discussions and debate on the federal level about our nation's infrastructure needs to power innovation and maintain a competitive edge over rivals such as Communist China, but that should not come at the expense of higher utility bills for Colorado families,

I am proud to have cosponsored the Ratepayer Protection Act, led by fellow Coloradan Representative Gabe Evans. [...] This bill will ensure that new investments in power generation and infrastructure aren't made at the expense of higher utility rates for the families in Colorado's Fifth Congressional District.

We have to lead in artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence is a lot like the internet. It's here. Right? We're not going to cover our eyes and say, oh, if we just cover it long enough, artificial intelligence won't be here.

China wants to beat us in artificial intelligence. I don't want China to lead in that. I want the country that has the First Amendment, respects religious freedom, the freedom of the press, and freedom of speech. That's the country that I want to lead in data centers and in AI. And that's the United States. So we have to lead.
